Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for the selected GLASS TIDE tilted 2.5D survival game. EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized square cells, landscape 1536x1024 image. Every cell has fully transparent background, no floor, no text, no borders, no checkerboard illustration, no shadows outside the object, no perspective background. ONE isolated object centered in each cell, with generous transparent padding (20 percent each side). All sprites viewed from the SAME elevated 55-degree camera, lit softly from upper-left. Beautiful highly detailed hand-painted sci-fi biological game art, pale ivory porous shells, green moss, lilac/coral fronds, translucent sea-glass membranes with warm amber veins. Art inspired by the provided Glass Tide reference, with coherent painterly colors, not realistic photo objects.
Cell top-left: low round porous ivory shell-rock mound supporting a lush alien rosette of translucent celadon glass leaves, tiny lilac coral branches and moss, roughly circular grounded base, no tall tree.
Cell top-middle: broken round ivory colony hull fragment, gracefully arched rib, moss and small alien pink reeds, modest height and circular grounded base.
Cell top-right: one full-body small human SURVIVOR, seen from back/three-quarter above, compact ochre ceramic hood, dark teal kelp-fiber cape, two legs and small asymmetric life-support pack, narrow human silhouette with feet aligned at bottom, NO weapon.
Cell bottom-left: one ACTIVE SENTINEL, compact floating teardrop seed-pod insect, clear teal/ivory translucent membranes around an amber branching nucleus and two dark chitin fins, distinctive angular hunting silhouette, body similar scale to survivor, no long spidery limbs, no monster face.
Cell bottom-middle: same sentinel in DORMANT form, closed pearly teardrop seed husk with subdued gray-mint veins, folded and smooth, no exposed amber nucleus.
Cell bottom-right: one small lush clustered clump of lavender/coral alien ferns with translucent pale green fronds and moss on a very small porous pebble, low ground decoration.
Each object's lowest grounded point is aligned at 82% of its cell height. Keep all artwork inside its own cell, never overlapping. This sheet will be cropped into six game sprites using exact equal cells. Truly transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a seamless square tileable 2D GAME GROUND TEXTURE for Glass Tide, a lush alien wetland. Orthographic straight-down top surface only, NO horizon, NO characters, NO creatures, NO rocks, NO objects, NO plants, NO UI, NO text, NO shadows of objects. Quiet finely painted submerged pale pearl silt seen through translucent muted teal/celadon water. Very subtle large soft caustic light patterns and delicate tiny scattered mottled sediment, lilac undertones. Low contrast, desaturated, restful ground so small amber creatures and dark humans can be read clearly against it. Seamless edges, no obvious central feature, no strong circles or strong stripes. Refined hand-painted sci-fi environment texture, believable but softly stylized. All pixels should be opaque.
